name: Cave of Machpelah

identification.note: Traditionally identified with a site beneath the Ibrahimi Mosque/Tomb of the Patriarchs in Hebron, though the cave itself has not been excavated.

related_people.name: Ephron
related_people.role: the Hittite who sold Abraham this cave as a burial place for Sarah

description: The burial cave Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite for Sarah, which became the family tomb for Abraham, Isaac, Rebekah, Jacob, and Leah as well (Genesis 23; 49:29-32).
